item.title: JUBILEE! Vinyl LP Record, Sisters' Concert Chorus, Grace Note Recordings, 1960s
item.description: Long-playing vinyl record featuring the Sisters' Concert Chorus performing sacred and classical music to commemorate the Diamond Jubilee Year (75 years) of the Sisters of St. Joseph of Nazareth, Michigan. Released on Grace Note Recordings label with original colorful gatefold cover. Both sides of vinyl visible; record shows light surface wear consistent with age. Includes full program notes, choir photograph, and historical text about the Sisters' mission and educational work.
